tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Statement issued on or after 01-04-2025 for preceding 3 years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 i.e. from 01.04.2023 to 31.03.2026 issued by the concerned Charted Accountant/Auditor as per Annexure-II. Annual turnover should be at least Rs. 25.00 lakhs per year

As the bid documents are digitally signed by the bidder while submitting through e-Procurement portal, it is understood that the bidder had signed all the documents including the tender documents within the meaning of digital signature under IT Act 2001

Attested copy of Partnership deed & Certificate of registration or By-Laws and rules regulations and certificate of registration of society in case of Society or Memorandum of Association and articles of Association and certificate of Incorporation of Company or Individual registration certificate
Attested copy of the Balance sheet and Profit & Loss A/c of the Bidder audited by a Chartered Accountant for Last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
Attested copy of the Income Tax returns filed by the Bidder for the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
Attested DIC/SSI certificate issued by competent authority
Attested Factory Registration certificate issued by competent authority
Attested PAN CARD copy of the Bidder
Details of the bidder in the Format at Annexure VII

GST Certificate Latest GST payment receipt as per Annexure-I or in the valid format of the commercial tax department for previous financial year issued by the concerned authorities is to be uploaded along with GST registration certificate and GST returns for the month of August2026
Performance Certificate for preceding three financial years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 issued by the Competent Authority
Proof for having multicolor offset printing facilities- Scanned copy of the invoice to be submitted
Tender Offer Form as per Annexure IV
